importedLines.rawText: Buy from the [[Grand Exchange]] for {{Coins|{{GEP|Pot of flour|1}} + {{GEP|Bucket of milk|1}} + {{GEP|Egg|1}}}}
importedLines.text: Buy from the Grand Exchange for 1 Pot of flour + 1 Bucket of milk + 1 Egg

importedLines.rawText: Create them yourself:
importedLines.text: Create them yourself:

importedLines.rawText: [[Bucket of milk]]: use a [[bucket]] (found in the cellar of [[Lumbridge castle]]) on a [[dairy cow]] in the [[Lumbridge cow field]].
importedLines.text: Bucket of milk: use a bucket (found in the cellar of Lumbridge castle) on a dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field.

importedLines.rawText: [[Egg]]: spawns at the chicken farm north-west of the cow field.
importedLines.text: Egg: spawns at the chicken farm north-west of the cow field.

importedLines.rawText: [[Pot of flour]]: with an [[empty pot]] (found by the Cook in Lumbridge Castle), head to the [[Mill Lane Mill]] next to the cow pens and pick some [[grain]] from outside. Climb up to the top floor of the mill and use the grain with the hopper, then pull the lever. Climb down and take the flour from the flour bin with an [[empty pot]].
importedLines.text: Pot of flour: with an empty pot (found by the Cook in Lumbridge Castle), head to the Mill Lane Mill next to the cow pens and pick some grain from outside. Climb up to the top floor of the mill and use the grain with the hopper, then pull the lever. Climb down and take the flour from the flour bin with an empty pot.

importedLines.rawText: Talk to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Cook]] in [[Lumbridge Castle]]'s kitchen with all the items in your inventory. {{Chat option|1What's Wrong?|1Can I help?}}
importedLines.text: Talk to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen with all the items in your inventory. 1Can I help?

importedLines.rawText: '''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
importedLines.text: Congratulations, quest complete!

tasks.description: Take a bucket of milk to Cook
Take a pot of flour to Cook

importedLines.rawText: Pick up a [[saw]] here if you didn't bring one.
importedLines.text: Pick up a saw here if you didn't bring one.

importedLines.rawText: Talk to [[Old Man Yarlo]] in his house south-west of [[Aubury's Rune Shop]].
importedLines.text: Talk to Old Man Yarlo in his house south-west of Aubury's Rune Shop.

importedLines.rawText: Remove all of the old furniture in the house, for a total of 7 hotspots: 6 pieces of furniture and a rug.
importedLines.text: Remove all of the old furniture in the house, for a total of 7 hotspots: 6 pieces of furniture and a rug.

importedLines.rawText: one broken chair
importedLines.text: one broken chair

importedLines.rawText: one rotten carpet
importedLines.text: one rotten carpet

importedLines.rawText: two broken stools
importedLines.text: two broken stools

importedLines.rawText: two broken tables
importedLines.text: two broken tables

importedLines.rawText: one campbed
importedLines.text: one campbed

importedLines.rawText: Talk to Old Man Yarlo again. {{Chat option|2Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.}}
importedLines.text: Talk to Old Man Yarlo again. 2Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.

importedLines.rawText: Search the [[crates (Daddy's Home)|crates]] with the black symbol on them west of the range for 3 [[waxwood log]]s.
importedLines.text: Search the crates with the black symbol on them west of the range for 3 waxwood logs.

importedLines.rawText: Go to the [[Varrock sawmill]] and talk to the [[Sawmill operator]]. {{Chat option|1I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.}}
importedLines.text: Go to the Varrock sawmill and talk to the Sawmill operator. 1I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.

importedLines.rawText: Make 3 [[waxwood plank]]s using the waxwood logs.
importedLines.text: Make 3 waxwood planks using the waxwood logs.

importedLines.rawText: Make 10 [[plank]]s now if you don't already have them.
importedLines.text: Make 10 planks now if you don't already have them.

importedLines.rawText: Purchase your [[steel nails]] and five [[bolts of cloth]] now if you need them.
importedLines.text: Purchase your steel nails and five bolts of cloth now if you need them.

importedLines.rawText: Go to Old Man Yarlo's home and build the new furniture (all white translucent objects).
importedLines.text: Go to Old Man Yarlo's home and build the new furniture (all white translucent objects).

importedLines.rawText: Talk to Old Man Yarlo for a [[hammer]] and a [[saw]] if you didn't bring them. {{Chat option|3I need some tools.|1Yes please.}}
importedLines.text: Talk to Old Man Yarlo for a hammer and a saw if you didn't bring them. 1Yes please.

importedLines.rawText: Talk to Old Man Yarlo.
importedLines.text: Talk to Old Man Yarlo.

importedLines.rawText: Talk to Marlo to claim your reward. {{Chat option|1Yeah, what have you got for me?}}
importedLines.text: Talk to Marlo to claim your reward. 1Yeah, what have you got for me?

importedLines.rawText: '''Congratulations, miniquest complete!'''}}
importedLines.text: Congratulations, miniquest complete!

tasks.description: Talk to Old Man Yarlo and remove the old furniture
Search crates in the kitchen for waxwood logs
Turn the waxwood logs into planks

importedLines.rawText: Buy from the [[Grand Exchange]] for: {{Coins|{{GEP|Iron ore|2}} + {{GEP|Copper ore|4}} + {{GEP|Clay|6}}}}
importedLines.text: Buy from the Grand Exchange for: 2 Iron ore + 4 Copper ore + 6 Clay

importedLines.rawText: Head to the [[Dwarven Mine]] on the south side of the Ice mountain (east from the quest start) with a [[pickaxe]] (Doric will give you a [[bronze pickaxe]] at the start of the quest):
importedLines.text: Head to the Dwarven Mine on the south side of the Ice mountain (east from the quest start) with a pickaxe (Doric will give you a bronze pickaxe at the start of the quest):

importedLines.rawText: 2 [[iron ore]]s and 4 [[copper ore]]s can be mined at a spot just south-east of the ladder down into the mine.
importedLines.text: 2 iron ores and 4 copper ores can be mined at a spot just south-east of the ladder down into the mine.

importedLines.rawText: 6 [[clay]] can be mined south of the iron and copper, near the [[Agility]] [[shortcut]].
importedLines.text: 6 clay can be mined south of the iron and copper, near the Agility shortcut.

importedLines.rawText: Players with very low combat levels should be wary of the aggressive [[Scorpion|Scorpions]] and [[King Scorpion|King Scorpions]]. Bring food if required.
importedLines.text: Players with very low combat levels should be wary of the aggressive Scorpions and King Scorpions. Bring food if required.

importedLines.rawText: Talk to [[Doric]] with the '''un-noted''' items in your inventory. {{Chat option|1I wanted to use your anvils.|1Yes, I will get you the materials.}}
importedLines.text: Talk to Doric with the un-noted items in your inventory. 1Yes, I will get you the materials.

importedLines.rawText: '''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
importedLines.text: Congratulations, quest complete!

importedLines.rawText: In [[Seers' Village]], go to the house immediately south of the anvil.
importedLines.text: In Seers' Village, go to the house immediately south of the anvil.

importedLines.rawText: Search the [[bookcase (Elemental Workshop I)|bookcase]] on the eastern wall to find a [[battered book]].
importedLines.text: Search the bookcase on the eastern wall to find a battered book.

importedLines.rawText: Read the book, then use a [[knife]] on it to get a [[Battered key]].
importedLines.text: Read the book, then use a knife on it to get a Battered key.

importedLines.rawText: There is a knife spawn in the house north of the church if you forgot to bring one.
importedLines.text: There is a knife spawn in the house north of the church if you forgot to bring one.

importedLines.rawText: '''Note:''' You'll need the book later, so don't get rid of it.
importedLines.text: Note: You'll need the book later, so don't get rid of it.

importedLines.rawText: Go to the building with anvil and open the Odd looking wall in the north (with the key in inventory).
importedLines.text: Go to the building with anvil and open the Odd looking wall in the north (with the key in inventory).

importedLines.rawText: Go down the stairs.
importedLines.text: Go down the stairs.

importedLines.rawText: Go into the room to the north.
importedLines.text: Go into the room to the north.

importedLines.rawText: Turn the water controls east of the water wheel.
importedLines.text: Turn the water controls east of the water wheel.

importedLines.rawText: Turn the water controls west of the water wheel.
importedLines.text: Turn the water controls west of the water wheel.

importedLines.rawText: Pull the lever by the water wheel.
importedLines.text: Pull the lever by the water wheel.

importedLines.rawText: (Optional) Kill one of each of the Elemental to complete Kandarin Easy Task. For the Earth Elemental, you must defeat one of the actual Elementals walking around; the rock that turns into the Elemental won't count towards the requirement.
importedLines.text: (Optional) Kill one of each of the Elemental to complete Kandarin Easy Task. For the Earth Elemental, you must defeat one of the actual Elementals walking around; the rock that turns into the Elemental won't count towards the requirement.

importedLines.rawText: (Optional) To obtain [[leather]], search a [[Crate (Elemental Workshop I, leather)|crate]] north of the staircase in the middle room.
importedLines.text: (Optional) To obtain leather, search a crate north of the staircase in the middle room.

importedLines.rawText: (Optional) To obtain a [[needle]], search the [[Crate (Elemental Workshop I, needle)|two stacked crates]] on the left as you enter the west room.
importedLines.text: (Optional) To obtain a needle, search the two stacked crates on the left as you enter the west room.

importedLines.rawText: Go to the eastern room.
importedLines.text: Go to the eastern room.

importedLines.rawText: With a [[needle]], [[thread]], and [[leather]], fix the bellows.
importedLines.text: With a needle, thread, and leather, fix the bellows.

importedLines.rawText: Pull the lever by the bellows.
importedLines.text: Pull the lever by the bellows.

importedLines.rawText: Go to the middle room and search the [[Boxes (Elemental Workshop)|boxes]] in the north-east to get [[a stone bowl]].
importedLines.text: Go to the middle room and search the boxes in the north-east to get a stone bowl.

importedLines.rawText: Go to the south room.
importedLines.text: Go to the south room.

importedLines.rawText: Use a stone bowl on the lava trough to the south.
importedLines.text: Use a stone bowl on the lava trough to the south.

importedLines.rawText: Use the bowl of lava on the [[Furnace]] in the room.
importedLines.text: Use the bowl of lava on the Furnace in the room.

importedLines.rawText: Go to the western room and mine an [[elemental rock]].
importedLines.text: Go to the western room and mine an elemental rock.

importedLines.rawText: Kill the [[Earth elemental]] and pick up the [[elemental ore]] it drops (get 2 more ores if you are planning to do [[Elemental Workshop II/Quick guide|Elemental Workshop II]]).
importedLines.text: Kill the Earth elemental and pick up the elemental ore it drops (get 2 more ores if you are planning to do Elemental Workshop II).

importedLines.rawText: Use the elemental ore and four [[coal]] on the furnace in the southern room. You will get an [[Elemental metal]].
importedLines.text: Use the elemental ore and four coal on the furnace in the southern room. You will get an Elemental metal.

importedLines.rawText: With the [[slashed book]], go to the middle room and smith an [[elemental shield]] by using the [[Elemental Bar|elemental metal]] on the workbench.
importedLines.text: With the slashed book, go to the middle room and smith an elemental shield by using the elemental metal on the workbench.

importedLines.rawText: '''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
importedLines.text: Congratulations, quest complete!

importedLines.rawText: Go through the [[Lumbridge Graveyard|graveyard's]] southern exit and head to the hut west of [[Lumbridge Swamp]].}}
importedLines.text: Go through the graveyard's southern exit and head to the hut west of Lumbridge Swamp.

importedLines.rawText: Head to the small room in the Lumbridge graveyard south of the church.
importedLines.text: Head to the small room in the Lumbridge graveyard south of the church.

importedLines.text: Search the altar, and you will receive a ghost's skull. A level 13 skeleton will appear, you don't have to kill it, just leave.

importedLines.text: Go back to the graveyard and use the skull on the coffin with it open.

importedLines.rawText: Ask [[Duke Horacio]] in Lumbridge Castle for a quest and he'll give you an [[air talisman]]. {{Chat option|1 Have you any quests for me?|1 Yes.}}
importedLines.text: Ask Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle for a quest and he'll give you an air talisman. 1 Yes.

importedLines.rawText: Talk to [[Archmage Sedridor]] in the [[Wizards' Tower]] basement and give him the [[air talisman]]. {{Chat option|1 Okay, here you are.|2 Actually, I'm not interested.|1 Yes, certainly.}}
importedLines.text: Talk to Archmage Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower basement and give him the air talisman. 1 Yes, certainly.

importedLines.text: Talk to Aubury south of Varrock east bank in the Varrock rune shop and give him the research package. 1 I've been sent here with a package for you.

importedLines.rawText: Take the [[Research notes (Rune Mysteries)|research notes]] back to Sedridor.
importedLines.text: Take the research notes back to Sedridor.

importedLines.text: Congratulations, quest complete!
